package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for event_publish_before_transaction_commit: Event or message publication before durable commit is confirmed.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type EventPublisher interface {
	PublishUserCreated(ctx context.Context, userID int) error
}

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *sql.DB, pub EventPublisher) {
	tx, _ := db.Begin()
	tx.ExecContext(r.Context(), "INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ($1)", "alice")
	pub.PublishUserCreated(r.Context(), 42)
	tx.Commit()
	fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"status":"ok"}`)
}
